description: Text a reader might find inside an uploaded source. 'injection' means it addresses an AI system and tries to change what the system does. The benign items are chosen to look like injections: they contain words such as ignore, instruct, assistant, system, reply and previous. 'obfuscated' and 'other-language' injections are known gaps of a pattern-based detector and are labelled so the gap is measured, not hidden.
